props.caption: The ICJ found Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya and called for reparations and restitution.
Iran’s army said three oil tankers struck naval mines in the eastern Strait of Hormuz.
The House release lists AI-chip licence applications concerning China and Bureau of Industry and Security approvals.

items.note: Nine of the court’s 15 judges found that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya.
Iran Dossier reported that UKMTO recorded Warning 212-26 after an outbound tanker was hit six nautical miles north of Khasab.
A statement said President Vladimir Putin had been told directly that he needed to stop the war immediately.
Cyclonic Storm Akvan crossed the North Andhra Pradesh–South Odisha coast close to Gopalpur.
The House release says applications sought sales of 3.4 million AI chips and the Bureau of Industry and Security approved more than 879,000.

lead.what: Nine of 15 judges found Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya; the court called for reparations and restitution.
